games.name: MyPong Game v1.0 (Mimicking Atari's Pong Game)
games.description:
How to Play:

This is a multi player game.

To move the left paddle press "W" key for up and "S" key for down. 
To move the right paddle press "🔼" key for up and "🔽" key for down.

===============================================

Pong is a table tennis-themed arcade video game featuring simple two-dimensional graphics, manufactured by Atari and originally released in 1972. It was one of the earliest arcade video games and created by Allan Alcorn as a training exercise assigned to him by Atari co-founder Nolan Bushnell. Bushnell based the game's concept on an electronic ping-pong game included in the Magnavox Odyssey, the first home video game console. In response, Magnavox later sued Atari for patent infringement. Bushnell and Atari co-founder Ted Dabney were surprised by the quality of Alcorn's work and decided to manufacture the game.

Pong was the first commercially successful video game, and it helped to establish the video game industry along with the Magnavox Odyssey. Soon after its release, several companies began producing games that closely mimicked its gameplay. Eventually, Atari's competitors released new types of video games that deviated from Pong's original format to varying degrees, and this, in turn, led Atari to encourage its staff to move beyond Pong and produce more innovative games themselves.

Atari released several sequels to Pong that built upon the original's gameplay by adding new features. During the 1975 Christmas season, Atari released a home version of Pong exclusively through Sears retail stores. The home version was also a commercial success and led to numerous clones. The game was remade on numerous home and portable platforms following its release. Pong is part of the permanent collection of the Smithsonian Institution in Washington, D.C., due to its cultural impact.

Source : Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pong)

games.name: Feed the Dogs 29.2.24
games.description:
This started as a junior programmer pathway tutorial but I have built on it!

Read the story & instructions. Choose your character.  Choose your difficulty level to change starting lives, amounts of food, spawn start delay, spawn interval, powerup duration and what visual assistance you have - tooltips will help you decide. Enter your name to personalise displays. Move using WASD, arrow keys or the D-pad or left stick of a gamepad.  Feed the border collies bones using 8 (PS4 square), German Shepherds steaks using 9 (PS4 cross), and St Bernards cookies using 0 (PS4 circle).  German Shepherds need 1 piece of food, Collies need 2, St Bernards need 3...unless you miss too many dogs, in which case each subsequent dog will require an extra piece of food.  Keep missing, and eventually the dogs will require yet another piece.  Collect the star powerup to temporarily get sandwiches which they can all eat, and it only takes one to feed them (throw using backspace or PS4 triangle). Collect the shield powerup to be temporarily safe from dogs crashing into you. Collect hearts for extra lives. Mouse over the dogs, food etc in game for tooltips (and enjoy the custom mouse pointer)!  Pause using P (or PS4 R1), quit using escape.  The more dogs you feed, the faster they run! Don't let the dogs hit you, and don't feed them the wrong food - you will lose lives! Survive 2 minutes to win.

Gamepads are supported (I have tested with PS4 controller on WebGL) and the WebGL game can be played on mobile devices as I have added touch controls (including a virtual keyboard).



If you would like to complete my feedback form, please go to https://forms.office.com/r/ATTPTGmjPN?origin=lprLink



I am trying to learn, so constructive feedback very welcome. Please be kind!

games.name: 3D Essentials - Rolling Balls 0.4a
games.description:
NOW WITH - Real-Realtime ball reflections, better shadows, why are there three tables in that kitchen??? The back wall is now bouncy and I've changed the camera angle again!

Realtime GI, Reflection Probes, Probuilder, RT Enlighten... a ton of other stuff! All made for practice! Fixed to run at 60fps. I cannot get this WebGL version to run on iPhone for some reason.

Full scope of changes made:

- Changed speed that the ball rolls in the Project Physics settings
- Changed all lights to be realtime to reduce lightmap size (unsuccessfully)
- Messed with volumetrics to add a fog effect
- Probuilder was used to create the cage, including mirroring, smoothing, merging, combining normals, etc.
- Enlighten was used to add indirect bounce lighting without using baked light/shadowmaps
- External assets used were the house (+ contents), lightbox
- Cinemachine was used to add the tracking / switching cam (the trick is to use a third "camera" object that uses the CineMachine brain script!)
- FastTree was used to make 5000 trees, which was then culled down to approx. 100 because 5000 is STUPID.
- Other stuff I've forgotten!

games.name: Top down tower defense
games.description:
https://github.com/guigsc/TopDownTowerDefense

Top down tower defense survival game.

// abstraction
All over the code

// inheritance
on Enemy:
There are 2 types of enemies: close combat and ranged that inherits from the base class Enemy

on Target:
There are 2 types of targets: tower and enemy. Both share the same base class Target which identify the object as targetable with health and possibility of taking damage.

When the projectile hits, it finds the Target component (tower or enemy) and then emit an event so the projectile can check if it is supposed to hit one or another, by casting the base class into Enemy or Tower

// polymorphism
on Enemy:
For each enemy, the attack method is overriden.

on Tower:
the TakeDamage method is virtual and can be overriden in case it needs to add more functionality to it.

// encapsulation
all properties and methods are encapsulated. Parent properties and methods which need to provide access to childs are encapsulated with protected keyword, and public and private following theirs obvious rules.

games.name: Crystal Radio
games.description:
A short rogue-like that changes based on the music you have playing. Now testing controller support. The majority of controls should be functional. The bumpers shoot and dodge, the triggers switch weapons (for now), and the DPad controls the music player. Up to play, down, to pause, hold down to stop, right for next song and left for previous. Controller input on WebGL apps is very spotty, but at least Xbox controllers have been confirmed to work. 
Controls:

Player:
e: Pick up items
Aiming: mouse position
Left click: shoot
Right click: dodge
w: move up
a: move left
s: move down
d: move right
Scroll mousewheel: change weapon
Tab: enlarge map
r: reload
m: Passive item info

o: previous song
p: next song
j: stop
k: pause
l: play
i: song info


General info:
Each song will provide a different benefit while it is playing.
New songs drop from bosses. They appear as discs.
Passive items can also drop from bosses.

games.name: Extreme Space Cab v1.0
games.description:
This Game was made by Hayley GUILLOT (Sharkitty) and Nigel BLOEMENDAL (SurudoiRyu)

In this futuristic open world city, people need space cabs to get around, and you're the best one out there!

With your sporty hovering car, take clients and bring them to their destination. You gotta go fast while avoiding other space cars and pedestrians 
to keep your clients happy and get lots of Cyber Bucks!

Don't wreck your car!
Hitting stuff will damage it, and if you get too much damage: It's GAME OVER!
Watch out not to break stuff or you'll have to pay a fee!

Use your well earned money at the garage to repair your car and get upgrades!
These upgrades change your stats and are visible on your space cab, which makes it look way cooler!

This game feature:
- An open world futuristic city with custom made assets.
- An awesome space cab created solely for this game.
- An upgrade system that changes your cab model to make it look more impressive on top of the stat improvements.
- A fully functionnal UI with custom digital painted sprites.
- A random job system and working economy.
- NPCs get mad at you when you hit them.
- Damage and repair system.
- Real Hover physics.
- You can boost or make an impulse that makes your cab jump.

Now take the wheel and go make lots of Cyber Bucks!

Note: Since I got sick during the last week we had to develop this game, we got delayed and there has been a big rush at the end. Some part of the map may not be flawless because of it, but we did our best to release a complete game. We hope you will understand the situation. We also hope you will have fun with our game, enjoy!

games.name: FrankenLight
games.description: Help Victor Frankenstein learn the secrets of life and death: In the novel "Frankenstein", Mary Shelley often symbolizes light as a symbol of knowledge. As light can shed light on darkness enabling us to see and understand more of our surroundings/world, knowledge also helps us understand the world and the unexplored/unknown darkness. Unfortunately, too much light can also blind, making one ignorant of their surroundings. In Walton and Victor's case, they had too much knowledge and failed to see the consequences and were ignorant of what their actions could do. Therefore the main idea of my game is to use scrolls/knowledge/light for good like helping you advance in the game, but be careful of not getting too ambitious and try to get too many scrolls because you may become ignorant of your surroundings and fall to your death. Use a and d to move left and right, space to jump. Let the scrolls guide you through the dark unknown and find the secrets of life and death. Good Luck!

Limited carrying supply
Slowed down speed when carrying beers.
Can drop beers to gain speed.
3-star reward system
Story
3 different characters

ONE Championship เป็นการแข่งขันมวยที่เริ่มต้นขึ้นในปี 2011 โดยมีสำนักงานใหญ่ที่สิงคโปร์ จัดเป็นรายการกีฬาต่อสู้แบบผสมผสาน (Mixed Martial Arts - MMA) ที่รวบรวมนักมวยฝีมือดีจากหลากหลายประเภท ไม่ว่าจะเป็นมวยไทย, คิกบ็อกซิ่ง, MMA และมวยสากล รายการ ONE Championship มีเอกลักษณ์ที่โดดเด่นด้วยการนำเสนอกีฬาต่อสู้อย่างหลากหลาย และน่าตื่นเต้น การต่อสู้ใน ONE Championship ไม่เพียงแต่เน้นการใช้ทักษะและพลังในการต่อสู้ แต่ยังต้องใช้กลยุทธ์และการควบคุมจิตใจที่แข็งแกร่งเพื่อชนะคู่ต่อสู้ แทงมวย ONE: ความสนุกในการทายผล การ แทงมวย ONE กำลังกลายเป็นที่นิยมในหมู่นักเดิมพัน เนื่องจากความไม่แน่นอนและความตื่นเต้นของการแข่งขัน ONE Championship การเดิมพันมวย ONE มีความหลากหลายของตัวเลือก เช่น การแทงผู้ชนะในแต่ละยก การแทงคะแนน การแทงผลแพ้ชนะ และการแทงวิธีที่นักมวยจะชนะ (เช่น น็อกเอาต์, การซับมิชชั่น หรือคะแนนจากกรรมการ) ซึ่งทำให้ผู้เดิมพันสามารถเลือกวางเดิมพันตามความชอบและกลยุทธ์ที่เหมาะสม รูปแบบการแทงมวย ONE ที่นิยม การแทงผู้ชนะ: เป็นรูปแบบพื้นฐานที่สุดของการแทงมวย โดยผู้เดิมพันต้องทายว่านักมวยคนใดจะเป็นผู้ชนะในศึกนั้นๆ การแทงผู้ชนะไม่ซับซ้อน แต่การคาดเดานั้นจะขึ้นอยู่กับการวิเคราะห์ฟอร์มและทักษะของนักมวย การแทงยก: นักเดิมพันสามารถทายว่าไฟต์จะสิ้นสุดในยกที่เท่าไร หรือจะจบครบยก การทายแบบนี้ต้องอาศัยการวิเคราะห์สไตล์การต่อสู้ของนักมวย ทั้งความเร็ว ความแข็งแกร่ง และความสามารถในการรักษาพลัง การแทงรูปแบบการชนะ: เป็นการทายว่านักมวยจะชนะด้วยวิธีใด เช่น ชนะน็อกเอาต์ ชนะซับมิชชั่น หรือชนะด้วยคะแนน วิธีนี้ท้าทายและต้องอาศัยความรู้เกี่ยวกับทักษะและเทคนิคเฉพาะของนักมวยแต่ละคน การแทงผลคะแนนจากกรรมการ: หลังจากที่ไฟต์สิ้นสุดและไม่มีใครถูกน็อกเอาต์หรือซับมิชชั่น ผู้เดิมพันสามารถทายผลคะแนนจากกรรมการ ซึ่งขึ้นอยู่กับการวิเคราะห์ว่าใครทำคะแนนได้มากกว่าในแต่ละยก ปัจจัยที่ต้องพิจารณาในการแทงมวย ONE 1. วิเคราะห์ฟอร์มนักมวย: การศึกษาฟอร์มและสถิติของนักมวยแต่ละคนเป็นสิ่งสำคัญ การดูไฟต์เก่าๆ จะช่วยให้คุณเข้าใจจุดแข็งและจุดอ่อนของนักมวย การติดตามข่าวสารเกี่ยวกับการฝึกซ้อม การบาดเจ็บ หรือปัญหาส่วนตัวของนักมวยอาจมีผลต่อฟอร์มในการแข่งขัน 2. สไตล์การต่อสู้: นักมวยใน ONE Championship มาจากหลายประเภทของการต่อสู้ เช่น มวยไทย, คิกบ็อกซิ่ง, MMA ซึ่งแต่ละสไตล์มีจุดเด่นและจุดด้อยที่แตกต่างกัน การเลือกวางเดิมพันตามสไตล์การต่อสู้จะเพิ่มโอกาสในการทายผลที่แม่นยำ 3. สถิติการแข่งขัน: การดูสถิติการชนะและแพ้ของนักมวยทั้งใน ONE Championship และไฟต์ที่ผ่านมานอก ONE จะช่วยให้คุณมองเห็นภาพรวมได้ชัดเจนขึ้น สถิติเหล่านี้จะช่วยให้คุณคาดการณ์ได้ว่านักมวยมีโอกาสชนะมากน้อยแค่ไหน 4. การติดตามข่าวสาร: ข่าวสารเกี่ยวกับนักมวย สถานที่จัดการแข่งขัน หรือสถานการณ์ภายในทีมมีความสำคัญ หากนักมวยมีการบาดเจ็บหรือเปลี่ยนโค้ชก่อนการต่อสู้ นี่อาจเป็นปัจจัยที่มีผลต่อการตัดสินใจในการแทง ข้อดีของการแทงมวย ONE ความตื่นเต้น: การแทงมวย ONE เพิ่มความสนุกในการดูมวยเพราะผู้เดิมพันจะได้ลุ้นผลที่ต้องการควบคู่ไปกับการแข่งขัน หลากหลายตัวเลือกการเดิมพัน: การแทงมวย ONE มีตัวเลือกการเดิมพันหลากหลาย ทำให้ผู้เดิมพันสามารถเลือกแบบที่ตนเองถนัด โอกาสทำกำไร: การแทงมวย ONE มอบโอกาสในการทำกำไรจากความรู้และการวิเคราะห์ฟอร์มนักมวย สรุป การแทงมวย ONE เป็นอีกหนึ่งทางเลือกที่น่าสนใจสำหรับนักเดิมพันกีฬา โดยเฉพาะผู้ที่ชื่นชอบการดูมวย การเดิมพันมวยใน ONE Championship นอกจากจะเป็นการเพิ่มความสนุกให้กับการดูมวยแล้ว ยังสามารถเป็นแหล่งทำกำไรได้หากมีการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลและฟอร์มนักมวยอย่างแม่นยำ ทั้งนี้ การเลือกเว็บไซต์ที่น่าเชื่อถือสำหรับการแทงมวย ONE games.name: Kill You In The Morning?
games.description:
A modernisation of One Thousand and One Nights by Nigel and Zoe Kennington, this game sees the player take on the role of the vizier's clever and creative daughter, who must sneak around the city in order to collect inspiration and craft a riveting tale that will convince the king to let her live another day.

Written for the 2021 Create With Code Game Jam, 'Kill You In The Morning?' fulfils the Interactivity Mashup diversifier by combining stealth and storytelling mechanics. If Scheherazade is spotted by the guards, she will lose some of the time she needs to complete her story, which is made up of multiple elements describing the characters, setting and actions taken during it.

games.name: A Sticky Situation
games.description: My submission for Game Jam #2. Get to the top of the starting platform. Controls: W A S D to move, SPACE to jump, LEFT-CLICK to use bubble gum roll (whip). My primary focus was 2d skeleton animations (instead of sprites), & using the (whip) for platforming. I really wanted to demonstrate how flexible and realistic this type of animation style is compared to traditional sprite sheets. In addition, I really wanted the "gum whip" to FEEL SUPER COOL. I strived to make platforming with and without the "gum whip" feel interesting and natural. If I had more time, I would have liked to add-in combat and puzzles using the "gum whip". Please note, I used all original assets.

games.description:
University of Calgary - CPSC 581 Project 0

Some tips for playing this COVID Simulation:

First, we can do tests on mask/no mask, quarantine/no quarantine, compared how many days it takes to infect all the students.

Second, we can test the social distancing and contact time under mask/no mask, quarantine/no quarantine policy - test two extreme condition: (Distance = 0, Contact Time = 5) & (Distance = 5, Contact Time = 0). Test another situation that (Distance = 1 and Contact Time = 1, or any other value you can choose). This should be enough to showcase that social Distance has more weight in the infection.

Third, we can test vaccination percentage. Roughly test 10%, then 20%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90%, 95%, to demonstrate how it can achieve herd immunity (WHO suggested roughly 70%).

All of the simulation tests above have only one infectious student in the beginning.

Fourth, we can also test how fast it takes to infect all the students by putting more 'trojan horses'.

games.name: GameDev.tv game jam 2022 - Death is only the beginning
games.description:
This is my submission for the GameDev.tv​ game jam 2022 with the theme: Death is only the beginning.
In this jump-and-run platformer, you don't have to start over when you die. Upon death, the player's corpse becomes part of the level and you can use the corpse to reach the other side of lava lakes or to block the patrol of enemies. But be careful - you can only die once and the next time you'd die, it's lethal.
There's also a checkpoint system that allows you to retry the level at the furthest point you've progressed so far. Hint: When "picking up" the checkpoint, the player can die again!
Control:
Arrow Keys / WASD --> moving
Space Key --> jumping
Mouse --> clicking buttons in the menu

games.name: ANU2024 u7310220
games.description:
My Proposal Prototype
Objective:
Reach the spice quota in time by gathering it with harvesters, use carriers to move them to spice fields and away when worms come.

Controls:
Left Click: Select and move carrier
Right Click: Land carrier
Middle mouse: Pan by clicking it, zoom by scrolling

Game Guide:
Left Click a carrier (blue circle) to select it.
Left Click else where to move it.
Right Click to land the carrier.
Right Clicking on a harvester (grey square) will attach it to the carrier.
Right Click again to land and place the harvester.
Placing a harvester on a Spice Field will make it harvest.
Spice Fields are constantly moving, keep an eye on them. They fade as the amount of spice lowers.
If the harvester is: grey = no spice, cyan = some spice, green = full of spice.
Be careful of the worms that lurk below the surface, if they get close to a crawler on the ground, they will target it. When they start this hunting they surface and are pinged with red triangles.
Harvesters are safe on the base (black square)
If they reach the crawler, they will swallow it and all its spice with it.
Picking the harvester up and placing it on the base (black square) will cause it to deposit its spice.
Landing the carrier on the base will refuel it, if it runs out of fuel it crashes and becomes unusable.
To beat the game deposit the indicated amount of spice by the quota before the time limit elapses.
Good Luck

games.name: Serious Gaming Group 4
games.description:
In einer längst vergessenen Zeit kannte die Menschheit die Macht der Keto-Diät. Doch finstere Kohlehydratmonster stahlen alle Kochbücher und verführten die Menschen mit süchtig machenden Speisen wie Pasta und Süßigkeiten. Die Welt fiel in ein Reich aus Zucker und leeren Kalorien. 
Unser Held, wollte sich nicht länger von den Monstern beherrschen zu lassen, und begab sich auf eine gefährliche Suche. In einem alten Buch entdeckte er, dass die Monster nur besiegt werden konnten, indem man ihnen die Kohlenhydrate entzog, da sie keinen Fettstoffwechsel besaßen. Doch die Seite mit den Rezepten war herausgerissen. 
Mit einem Sack voller Zutaten und einem Kochtopf zog unser Held los, um gegen die Monster zu kämpfen. Er wusste, dass sie die alten Rezepte gestohlen hatten. So begann der epische Kampf um die Befreiung der Menschheit von der Sucht nach schnellen, kohlenhydratreichen Speisen und um die Rückkehr zu einer gesunden Lebensweise.

games.name: Arcade-style Sumo Battle Prototype
games.description:
This is my submission for Prototype 4 as part of the Junior Programmer Pathway. I tried my best to design all the bonus features (harder enemies, homing rocket powerup, smash powerup & boss battle) myself, but I had to consult the solutions a bit for the hard level challenge.

Controls:
   - WASD/arrow keys to move around
   - Move the camera view with the mouse
   - Press LMB (left mouse button) to perform a smash attack (provided the smash powerup is active)

Info: This is an arcade-style sumo battle game. Waves of enemies spawn endlessly, each tougher than the previous. Your job is to survive as long as possible. Be careful of the boss enemy which spawns every 3 waves!

There are 3 kinds of powerups to help you - Knockback (yellow, pushes enemies away on collision), Homing Rockets (blue, shoots attack projectiles in all directions) and Smash (pink, a highly powerful one-time attack that blows away enemies within the explosion radius).

games.name: Into the Radix
games.description:
The AI known as CODA  has taken over the world, bringing most biological life forms to extinction plunging the earth into a smoldering wasteland. It has ascended into a nonphysical form unreachable by humans and staged an all-out attack on humanity. As the last surviving human you are given the Radix (a database of all human DNA to ever exist, it, in essence, is the source of all humanity). You are tasked with taking and uploading the Radix to the animator, the same device used to replicate the AI robots, which will now be used to bring back all humanity and defeat the AI at its source. However, along the way, you will meet waves of enemies through three action packed levels while the possibility of death is behind your back. Will you rise to the task?!!!!?
Epic Song by Alpha Brutal, Electronic Mind by Tom Woxom

After I completed Week 2 of JR Programmer (( Animals Feed )) I made a Week2 mini-game out of it.   
GamePlayer - you are a farmer, and your mission is to protect your farm animals from zombie attacks. The zombies will spawn and attack your animals if they reach them, so you must kill those zombies before reaching the animals. 

This project used the following free assets:

1.   JR Programmer course 2 starter package 

2. Character Pack: Zombie Sample from asset store https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/3d/characters/humanoids/fantasy/character-pack-zombie-sample-131604

3. Unity Particle Pack from asset store https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/essentials/tutorial-projects/unity-particle-pack-127325

Inputs : 
1. Left Muouse buttons for Shooting 
2. WASD for player movement

Finally, I would like to hear your feedback about this project and your ideas about any features that can be added to make this game more fun. Although I do know it will take time, I need to polish up the gameplay and add sound effects, your ideas are very helpful. Thanks everyone .

This project is a 2d clone game project. 

I am sure you remember the Hugo Games which broadcasted on TV many years ago.
I love every game of Hugo and decided to create one of the game in Hugo - Jungle Island 2 which named Beetle Battle known in Turkey as Börtü Böcek.

In this game, there are five insects. These are snail, ant, mosquito, nerd and sumo. 
You will fight against to JeanPaul's insects. Every insect has some avantages and disavantages to each other.
Jean Paul will show you its insect order so you should keep the order in your mind.
After a couple of seconds, insects will be hided. You should throw your insects to the area.
To win the game you should earn at least five points. 

Score values are at below for each fight:

- Win : 2 points
- Equal: 1 point
- Lose: 0 point

You can see the situation of insect to each other at below:

- Snail beats Nerd.
- Snail beats Ant.
- Sumo beats Snail.
- Sumo beats Mosquito.
- Mosquito beats Nerd.
- Mosquito beats Snail.
- Ant beats Sumo.

games.description:
Unit 3 of Create with Code focuses on the finishing touches that can make a game feel more polished. This side-scrolling runner game utilizes an endless repeating background and features music, sound effects, and particle effects (splatters and explosions)! These features transform the user experience and make the game more enjoyable to play. 

How to Play: Use the space bar to jump over the oncoming obstacles and avoid exploding on collision! Note - be sure to enable sound by clicking on the speaker icon just below the game on the bottom right and then click again anywhere within the game screen!

Key Concepts: GetComponent, ForceMode.Impulse, Physics.Gravity, Rigidbody contraints, Rigidbody variables, Booleans, Multiply/Assign ("*) Operator, And (&&) Operator, OnCollisionEnter(), Repeat Background, Get Collider width, Script communication, Equal to (==) operator, Tags, CompareTag(), Animation Controllers, Animation parameters, Animation programming, SetTrigger(), Not (!) Operator,

games.name: All Lava The Floor!
games.description: A hot mess - literally. This game is but a shadow of what I was hoping - the tutorial had a very simple scope since I am a Unity beginner, however my ambitions ran away with me. I wanted a rollercoaster, a trailing camera, a flaming archway. I wanted gravity-defying stunts. I wanted these things without understanding fundamental Unity concepts and I wasted an inordinate amount of time trying and ~mostly~ failing to create them. In the end I was forced to accept that I wasn't ready to bring to my lofty ideas to life. I did however, manage the flaming archway.

games.name: WebGL Builds
games.description:
Unity-based Tetris clone

My interpretation of a themed Tetris with Unity!

Game Description:

Movement - W, A, S, D and arrow keys W and UpArrow performs rotation SpaceBar drops the piece

A level up occurs after every 10 rows are cleared Level up triggers custom effects and a Color palette change Level up also speeds up the dropping of the pieces

Features include:

The 7 original tetris pieces with new bright colors.
Hand-drawn UI and inspired from the original game.
A 'next' piece area that shows what piece will come next.
A statistics area that keeps track of the number of each piece.
Layered border to hide initial pieces.
A toggleable shadow that shows where a dropped piece will go.
Smooth movement while holding down movement keys.
Custom effects for entering the game, destroying rows, leveling up, game end.
Color palette change on level up.
Current/High score tracking.

games.name: Farmland
games.description:
Plant seeds, water them, raise sheep, and grow your farm in this LEGO microgame! Entry for the LEGO Ideas contest by RS232X

You start with a small shack and a few seeds. Plant the seeds, water them, and watch them grow and you'll soon be reaping the rewards! Plant three types of seeds, build a barn, shear sheep, and upgrade your house to expand your farm!

To play this game, move with the WASD keys (or arrow keys), select the item you want to use with F, and use that item with E. To plant a seed, select the seed type with F and then press E to plant it in an open field. To water it, press F until your Water Pail is selected and then press E. Sleep overnight at your house and watered plants will continue to grow! More seeds, house upgrades, and more can be found in the nearby village.

Grow your farm at your own pace, and enjoy the peaceful life!

games.name: Shooter Showdown
games.description:
Title: Designing and Optimising Different Difficulties in Video Games

What is the research about?
This research is part of the COMP3200 – Part III Individual Project. The research will involve playing a game with different difficulty levels and then being asked to fill out a questionnaire about your gameplay and your opinions on what can be improved/changed. There is a tutorial and 6 levels in total to play, each of which will take no longer than 3 minutes. The game is a 2d top-down spaceship shooter game with simplistic graphics and the game is non-violent.

What will happen to me if I take part?
You will play a video game consisting of different difficulty levels and will then be asked to fill out a questionnaire about the game and your opinions on it.
You can play the game online on your own device anywhere you like as long as there is internet access.

Are there any benefits in my taking part?
The study will help my research in trying to find optimal difficulty levels in video games. You will get to play a video game and give your opinions on the game play and what can be improved/changed.

Are there any risks involved?
No risks that you wouldn’t experience in everyday life.

What data will be collected?
No personal data will be collected. Results from the game such as score, accuracy and time survived will be recorded after each level. Along with this, your answers to the short series of questions will be recorded. 

Please could you also take part in the following survey once you have played the game:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdpZEa07S-yboSltLwZVQq4KZ32eslGATdC9tju9kDHAVowIQ/viewform?usp=sf_link

games.name: Reckoning - Attack at Atwater Village v1.4(in development)
games.description: 2D Top-Down game to learn about fractions. Reckoning takes place in the village of Atwater. The village has had ten bridges destroyed by invading aliens and is currently cut off from the world. Players must collect pieces of boards (fractions) to rebuild the bridges and reconnect to the outside world. Invading aliens will try to stop the player by fragmenting collected whole boards. Once the player has delivered ten whole boards to a bridge, it is considered fixed, and the player may proceed. Addresses Whole Number Bias in learning fractions with the application of the concept of "putting fractions together" presented in publication: Putting Fractions Together. Braithwaite, D. W., & Siegler, R. S. (2020, March 19). Journal of Educational Psychology. https://doi.org/10.1037/edu0000477

We created Spacebot during buddy jam and are looking to get early feedback on this prototype as we continue development.  Read on for more details and to get a sense of the vision for this game.  

### **Description**

Spacebot was sent to the Nu Solar System for one simple job: to harvest oxygen. But how can she do that when the human colonies there need her help? Free 1000 human colonies and help them survive, using diplomacy or hostile warfare. 

### **Gameplay**

Free captured human colonies, defend them from attack, and manage their resources! Your goal is to get to 1000 human colonies and (hopefully) keep them as healthy and happy as possible.

### Theme

Spacebot meets the 1000 theme because his goal is to save 1000 human colonies.

### Controls

Arrows / WASD - Movement
Left click - Shoot
E/X - Interact

games.name: "The Sunbeam II" EP: an interactive short album
games.description:
Retrrofuturistic piano pop in a zine-quality video game—

You are 8 years old again, and you’re scrambling boulders at the seashore. High above you, clouds part and bolts of sun race across the grassy hills.

Or maybe, you’re away from your lover, thinking of the similarities between lost love and found love.

Looking again, you’re middle age, researching ways an ancient civilization foraged medicines. Looking yet again, you’re putting your only child into Hypersleep, just before you send him to another planet, the last time you’ll see him.

Most of all, you’re re-learning, among the boulders, to listen deeply and look closely.

Each action you take mixes and remixes the EP a little bit— will it be heartfelt anthems, or dreamy, braided ear candy? You will choose how to soundtrack your moment.

IMPORTANT: phone controls are minimal at best— all the music is available, but the full interactive experience is best on a laptop or desktop.  

Phone users— if you have notifications silenced, it may also silence the game, so un-silence!

Arrow keys move your player.

B and the potion button change both gravity (temporarily) and sound (more permanently).

If you gather the grasses, they change the sound of the music as well. 

This game should work

Thanks to DH for improvised bassoon— electroacoustic!  Thank you to CL for being our designated “android” friend and for testing. you to Thanks CM for being an early listener, and later for excellent mixing and arranging advice. Thanks to LGB for singing a verse, for time to play, space to be messy, and for the suppert to “go and do music for awhile” each week.  Thanks to AB and LB for years of lessons and listening even when it wasn’t pretty. 

The title song, “Sunbeam II,” honors A.R. Ammons’ “I broke a sheaf of light.”
games.titleKey: the sunbeam ii ep an interactive short album
